paper: Orthogonal Subspace Decomposition for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection (Yan et al., ICML 2025)
training_set_in_paper: GenImage SD v1.4 (Table 9, the released effort_clip_L14_trainOn_sdv14.pth); ProGAN for the UniversalFakeDetect tables (checkpoint not released); FF++ c23 for the face tables.

paper_number.note: Paper Table 9: MJ 82.4, SD1.4 99.8, SD1.5 99.8, ADM 78.7, GLIDE 93.3, Wukong 97.4, VQDM 91.7, BigGAN 77.6.

our_number.note: 89.83 (mAP 99.37) with the official checkpoint and DeepfakeBench's test transform (tag effort_genimage_full, job 269039).

benchmarks.name: UniversalFakeDetect (ProGAN-trained, 19 subsets)
benchmarks.metric: mAP and mean accuracy at 0.5, mean over the 19 subsets

paper_number.note: Paper Tables 2-3 (19 subsets: 11 ForenSynths GAN sets + Guided, LDM x3, Glide x3, DALL-E); accuracy at the fixed threshold 0.5. The authors released no ProGAN checkpoint, only the training code.

our_number.note: Not served (CC BY-NC weights, trained in SynthScope): the official UniversalFakeDetect_Benchmark recipe (experiments/image/effort_ufd.sh, ProGAN 20 classes, 24000 iterations, job 276492), iteration 18000 (the official selection): mAP 99.20 / mAcc 94.81 over the 19 subsets (AUROC 99.04); every subset's accuracy is within 1.7 pt and its AP within 2.5 pt of the paper (bench_eval.py --model-config image/effort_ufd, official translate_duplicate(256) + CenterCrop(224) test transform; tags effort_ufd_step18000_{gan11,ufd8,ufd19}, job 278691). Later iterations are lower: 21000 98.99 / 92.38, 24000 98.97 / 91.98 (fake recall falls on DeepFakes, SAN, Guided and Glide).
